backend.command:
python3 -c "import importlib, sys; from pathlib import Path; module = importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1][:-3].replace('/', '.')); payload, receipt = module.apply(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes())
with Path(sys.argv[3]).open('xb') as output:
    output.write(payload)
print(receipt)" mod_editor/core/nfl2k5_zone_drop.py <source.xbe> <new-copy.xbe>

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Opt-in witness disc only; off in every preset.

input_constraints: User-owned pinned USA executable or a recognized composed stack with the full selected owner request set reserved.
Exact position byte 18 and ordinary deep modes only; depth cap 0.50..0.84, default 0.84. Lateral demand still reaches 0.84.
The integrated allocator reserves two RX pages when required. The full selected owner union must be sealed before growth; rebuild from base when changing the union.
portme: Run Noah's paired Cover 3 go/curl/comeback, Cover 2 safety, Cover 4 and lifecycle witness list.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Static and bounded instruction proofs, complete allocator composition and offline disc builds. No game boot, rendered backpedal or full-play interception outcome witnessed.

fields.allowed: false in Basic, Advanced and Experimental; explicit witness opt-in only
fields.name: zone_drop_cap

selectors.notes: Implies xbe_space. Backend apply(cap=...) accepts 0.50..0.84 and requires a clean rebuild for a different cap. Only consider Experimental preset promotion after Noah's witness.

source_container.resource: five-byte initial depth-curve call and an 80-byte named RX allocation; no persistent writable state
source_container.retail_file: user-owned default.xbe in an NFL 2K5 USA disc

summary: Cap the initial deep-zone depth request for exact cornerback identities. Later steering and ball-response code remain unchanged.
title: Corner deep-zone backpedal (experimental, unwitnessed)
